name: Do I need to move out during a tile and surface update?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to move out during a tile and surface update?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most tile and surface update projects, you do not need to move out of your home. However, there might be periods of dust, noise, and limited access to the work area, especially in kitchens or bathrooms during the renovation. We strive to minimize disruption and will discuss any potential inconveniences with you upfront, allowing you to plan accordingly for your comfort and safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typically, you don't need to move out, but expect dust, noise, and limited access to the work area during the update.
